title: Illustrations alongside your own deck
description: Pictures and short stories help organize difficult study material.

blocks.text: For a diagram or for anatomy the image can be the content of the exercise itself.

quote.text: In the past, I have had to convert my own notes into pictures or mnemonics to retain information. Picmonic has streamlined my learning. Now I can take notes on the topic at hand traditionally and reinforce my knowledge with Picmonic.

blocks.text: Link a vetted illustration, an explanation and your own questions, allowing personal cards to sit alongside. Show which revision of the material it is.
Study facts need checking against the subject; a striking picture does not confirm that they are accurate.
